components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action such as 检测我的接口 or 提交站点.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2ee6a6); color: #06070a; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 18px; font-weight: 650; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5ff0bd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2ee6a6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #a7b1c2); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #232b37); border-radius: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text, #e9edf4); border-color: #33404f; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The main content container for tables and grouped data.
components.html:
中转站实时榜单

共 22 家站点，按综合分排序。
components.css: .ds-panel { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0c1117, #090d12); border: 1px solid #1a1f28; border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px 24px; color: #e9edf4; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #a7b1c2; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Toolbar search for stations and models.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="搜索站点 / 域名" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #06070a; border: 1px solid #232b37; border-radius: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; color: #e9edf4; font-size: 13px; width: 240px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6d788b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2ee6a6; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #2ee6a6; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Service and purity filters above the leaderboard.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #232b37; border-radius: 999px; color: #a7b1c2; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { color: #6d788b; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; margin-left: 6px; } .ds-chip.on { background: rgba(46,230,166,.12); border-color: rgba(46,230,166,.3); color: #2ee6a6; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Operational / degraded / outage label used across status surfaces.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #232b37; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; color: #a7b1c2; } .ds-pill.ok { color: #2ee6a6; border-color: rgba(46,230,166,.3); } .ds-pill.warn { color: #f5b942; border-color: rgba(245,185,66,.3); } .ds-pill.bad { color: #ff5d5d; border-color: rgba(255,93,93,.3); }

narrative.overview: RelayRadar 看起来像一台持续运行的监测仪表：深炭底色压住画面，荧光绿只标记“信号正常”与主行动，数据以等宽字体成列排布。页面不追求营销页的装饰，而追求读数清晰、层级可扫、状态一眼可辨。信息密度高，但靠留白分组：标题上方留白大于下方，卡片只包裹真正成组的内容，其余用细线和编辑式分栏。动效克制，只服务于“数据在更新”和“状态变化”。
keyCharacteristics: 深炭底、单一信号绿、三色状态（绿/琥珀/红）
数据用等宽字体、表格数字对齐
扁平为默认，浮起只属于 hover、浮层与告警
中文优先，中文标题比英文标签重

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: 信号绿是“正常/主行动”的专用色；不要用它装饰标题、边框或背景。

rules.name: The Status Only Rule
rules.body: 琥珀与红只表达状态，不用于品牌强调。

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: 所有数字列使用 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums，榜单不因刷新抖动。

rules.name: The No Gradient Text Rule
rules.body: 强调靠字重、字号与颜色，不用渐变文字。

dos: Do 让信号绿只出现在主行动、正常状态和关键数字上。
Do 用等宽数字与表格对齐承载比较。
Do 让标题上方留白大于下方。
Do 用中文承担主要信息，英文只做辅助标签。
donts: Don't 用渐变文字、光晕或玻璃模糊做装饰。
Don't 用单侧彩色边条装饰卡片。
Don't 用大数字 + 小标签的营销 Hero 替代真实数据。
Don't 用琥珀或红色表达非状态信息。
